scope: Independent read-only frontend, guarded projection, source replay and bounded-page review. No new source execution, solver or provider calls.

checks.finding: Opaque conditional ProgramIR node contains only eager test operand. Then/else roots live in required source-bound sidecar. Context rows add normal test completion plus the selected truthiness result; both branches are not represented as eager operands.

ASSERT has one predicate. Message root is separate and conditioned on command reachability, assertions enabled, normal predicate completion and false truthiness. Formatted-value operands preserve value then format-spec ordering before conversion/format obligations; later components require earlier normal completion.

Graph validator traverses eager and side roots, enforces function/symbol/source-span ownership, acyclicity, exact reachability, and conservative MAY-read effects. Failed outer expressions prune successful inner graphs. Unsupported control flow remains a diagnostic/fence; per-function structural completion does not confer program proof.

FOL and SMT project unresolved guarded implications; SMT guard-to-source binding is an explicit prerequisite with no asserted assumptions. Lean per-source declarations retain unresolved guard and requirement parameters. ProgramIR projection is explicitly incomplete without guarded extension. Source proof/discharge flags stay false or zero.

V1 straight-line matchers apply only to complete functions without guarded/assert/format constructs; new compound IDs and contexts keep entry reachability unresolved. This does not derive a matcher for guarded eigenpair implementations.

Exact source/report replay is required before linking or paging. New selection requires both explicit v2 profile and schema; wrong or mixed values cannot be relabeled into valid reports. Consumer pins selected and reused implementations and binds v2 profile into tree/record/planning identity.

Pages preserve whole original rows including all evaluation contexts. Exact query/report/context receipt bind continuations, canonical UTF-8 envelope and cursor overhead count against byte limit, and deterministic cursor boundaries reject skipped/replayed foreign offsets. Source/producers/artifacts are fenced after retrieval.

V2 pending rows retain guarded-region references, interpretation and unverified flags. Global summary states branch/message deferral; assertions omit nested contexts but retain references. Whole-row dropping records omissions under 8192 bytes. Full contexts remain available in replayed report and pending retrieval rows.

limitations: An individual obligation with very deep contexts can exceed the 8192-byte consumer page budget. Existing pager safely refuses it; this is not a promise that every syntactically accepted program is retrievable under every budget.

Standalone graph validation is structural custody, not Python/library semantics. Exact-source replay is still required and runtime identity, truthiness, effects, reachability and obligations remain unproved.
Review pins represent files at review time; final qualification must use stable final source hashes.

observed_fence.detail: Authored planner delivery reached planning; admission then refused numerical artifacts/producers changed while numerical_source_v2.py changed during the test. Captured before and after hashes substantiate the fence; this failed run is not final qualification.
